## What's new

- ChaOS Transfer: the folder path has a line of its own once you're a folder or two deep, instead of crowding the logo and buttons. A Back button goes up one folder, Device wears a house, and a deep path folds its middle into … (click it for the rest).
- The website: a little boot on the header's logo instead of the full-screen one, and a slideshow of what ChaOS adds, with captions.
- README, CREDITS and the website say ChaOS is made with AI-assisted programming.

---

ChaOS 2.4.1 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.4.1-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.4.1-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
